mapper.insert: insert into task_state_history(tenant_id,history_id,task_id,from_status,to_status,reason_code,reason,actor_type,actor_id,correlation_id,transition_at,task_version,idempotency_key) values(#{entry.tenantId},#{entry.historyId},#{entry.taskId},#{entry.fromStatus},#{entry.toStatus},#{entry.reasonCode},#{entry.reason},#{entry.actorType},#{entry.actorId},#{entry.correlationId},coalesce(#{entry.transitionAt},now()),#{entry.taskVersion},#{entry.idempotencyKey}) on conflict do nothing
mapper.select: select * from task_state_history where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and task_id=#{taskId} order by transition_at desc limit #{limit}
select * from task_state_history where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and idempotency_key=#{idempotencyKey} limit 1
